## Static provenance defect in unmerged PR #32

Reviewed head: `1b1ab50181de8e0dcde7841348af867d43653a11` (still open when rechecked).
Affected record: [pm-ado-5w3m.toon](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/blob/1b1ab50181de8e0dcde7841348af867d43653a11/.agents/pm/issues/pm-ado-5w3m.toon#L11-L15), plus its appended close history and close_reason.

The canonical goal is to independently measure and enforce the statement-coverage threshold, preserving the other coverage dimensions and rejecting a meaningful below-threshold fixture.

### Reproduction by inspecting the proposed tracker change

1. Read the record at the reviewed head. It sets completed_at to 2026-10-04T12:58:08Z and resolution/actual_result/close_reason to [PR #16](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/16), merge `fc8289f54e3e6c0e7da78588c88e05faf531770d`, head `e71531111b916e69ad0098f483fd30e658b211cc`.
2. Inspect #16's final description and patch. That certification created/documented the statement-coverage gap and explicitly left independent statement enforcement open; its green checks did not deliver this goal.
3. Inspect [PR #19](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/19). It adds independent statement instrumentation and enforcement, failed-threshold fixtures, and receipts. It merged at 2026-10-08T01:19:51Z, merge `f297a71431debfe2e00adb8dd1b02874e6dadfe2`, head `119b225ec6f84bf8c53ee6c953dba0980ddc6f1a`. The item's retained October 7 comments also describe that later implementation.

### Expected versus actual

Expected: closeout uses the PR that satisfies the current item's acceptance criteria and records that delivery's verified timestamp, revision and check evidence.
Actual: it records the earlier gap-reporting PR as delivery, dating completion four days before the actual merge and attaching unrelated head-check evidence.

The implementation does exist in #19; this report does not claim statement enforcement is currently missing. The defect corrupts durable delivery provenance and completion chronology in the proposed closeout.

### Regression acceptance

- Select #19's delivery evidence for this item, after verifying its checks, rather than treating #16's mention of the item as delivery
- Reconcile completed_at, resolution, actual_result, close_reason and the corresponding proposed close-history evidence consistently
- Add a closeout regression where an earlier merged PR introduces/describes an unresolved issue and a later merged PR satisfies it; reject the earlier PR as delivery
- Preserve prior historical evidence and distinguish offline implementation acceptance from any still-pending live Azure acceptance

Scope: static comparison of immutable tracker and delivery PR patches, not a rerun of implementation tests or live Azure services. All-status issues/PRs, current PM records and #32 discussion were checked before filing. The existing [September changelog-heading thread](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ado/pull/32#discussion_r4301991646) is a separate defect.
Closeout records gap-reporting PR #16 as statement-enforcement delivery instead of #19

value.text: Ownership check: this repository only configures the reusable pm-github closeout workflow and package version. Delivery candidate selection and chronology are implemented in pm-github closeout.ts (runCloseout), not in pm-ado configuration. Issue #33 belongs to pm-github selection/provenance logic; no existing history rewritten and no item closed here.

### GitHub comments (1)

> **@unbraind** (2026-10-20T16:59:19Z)
>
> Root cause is in pm-github's closeout matcher, not in pm-ado: it treated any merged PR that mentioned the item as its delivery. Fix in review: unbraind/pm-github#159. A PR now counts as delivering an item only when it declares delivery with a closing keyword next to the exact id or link, or in a structured item declaration. A mention, follow-up, gap note or tracker URL alone leaves the item open. If several PRs qualify, the latest merge wins, and every completion field and the close history use that PR's evidence. The regression covers exactly this case: an earlier gap-reporting PR and a later delivering PR select the later one. After the pm-github release, the next closeout run regenerates pm-ado#32 with #19 as the delivery.
